about: The registry of verified security sweeps (MA-363). A sweep is /sec-check --sweep <zone>: the verified-security-sweep skill over one zone, run monthly on Arun's yes, one zone a month in turn. The lead adds an entry to sweeps when a sweep ends: zone id, date, the commit swept, the Jira keys it filed, and a one-line result. Nothing here holds a secret's value.
